title: Stopping a search
body:
Hi,
im trying to toggle between different search index trough different screens
Hence i have a dropdown with the 2 search options (companies or projects)
I'm using the urlsync because i need to be able to bookmark the url to retrieve a search results instantly later on.

I have 2 searchBox widget, 2 agolia search instances, and this 2 instances are started immediately.
I would like to be able to stop/start the search instance so that the url sync works fine when i toggle from one to another index
